general_information.Description: Students will learn to code in Java and improve their programming and problem-solving skills. Students will learn to design algorithms as well as develop and debug programs. Using custom open-source classes, you will write programs that access and transform images, websites, and other types of data Use the data structures to build more complex programs that use Java’s object-oriented features After class students can solve real world problems with Java using multiple classes. Learn how to create programming solutions that scale using Java interfaces. Recognize that software engineering is more than writing code - it also involves logical thinking and design.
general_information.StudentTasks: Students complete the online courses MOOC1-MOOC3 (see details in the Materials page) and get certifications for MOOC1-MOOC3 to be allowed to take Final Exam
general_information.Note: 1. Students complete the online courses MOOC1-MOOC3 (see details in the Materials sheet) and get certifications for MOOC1 - MOOC3 to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam: 100% 3. Bonus 1 point when complete the courses before deadline 4. Completion Criteria: Final Exam Score+ bonus >= 5
